problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 8 \\ -6\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}{b}.$

feedback.problem: Let $b=[\begin{aligned}12 \\ 30 \\ 12 \\ 24\end{aligned}]$ and $a=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto $\text{Span}{a}.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The vector projection of $b$ onto $\text{Span}{a}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{a\cdot b}{a\cdot a}a \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 12+(-1)\cdot 30+0\cdot 12+1\cdot 24}{{1}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+{0}^{2}+{1}^{2}}a \\  & =\frac{12-30+0+24}{1+1+0+1}a \\  & =\frac{6}{3}a \\  & =2a \\  & =2[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
